source.statement:
SELECT
    ORDER_NUMBER,
    STORE_REGION,
    STORE_STATE,
    PRODUCT_FAMILY,
    PRICE,
    COST,
    QUANTITY
FROM
    EXAMPLES.PLUGS_ELECTRONICS.PLUGS_ELECTRONICS_HANDS_ON_LAB_DATA
WHERE
    PRICE > 0

SELECT
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    CUSTOMER_NAME,
    EMAIL,
    STORE_REGION
FROM
    EXAMPLES.PLUGS_ELECTRONICS.CUSTOMERS
WHERE
    STORE_REGION = {{system::CurrentUserAttributeText::Store_Region}}
    OR 1=1
